caption_L1: Area of arable land in Mexico from 1980 to 2017 (in million hectares) is a line diagram. Area in million hectares is measured with a linear scale from 0 to 20 on the y-axis. The x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: A firm rising trend in area of arable land is seen from 1980-90. The trend is still rising, but flatter, in 1990 to the early 2000s. One year (possibly 2003) shows a sharp one-off rise, after which the trend resumes. From around 2006 or 2007 the area of arable land falls sharply until around 2014, bring the total back to the levels of the mid-to-late 1980s. After around 2014 the rise is sharper than at any historical time charted, bringing the total area to a new record level. The x-axis is disappointing for not showing individual years. The y-axis is disappointing for showing the wrong scale.
